blockers.summary: Whitepaper-aligned pragmatics, mode/scope permissions, context fields, canonical JSON decoding, compact compiler mapping, and host mode-to-capability authorization are merged on main via PR #12. Executable verification remains open because current GitHub Actions runs fail before any job step executes.

Whitepaper canonical ordered-Octad Lattice grammar, atomic/framed/named/stream forms, separate compact grammar profile, canonical parser/compiler, and initial canonical-Lattice fixtures are implemented in PR #13. Closure requires executable engineering/conformance evidence and merge evidence.

Authorization references, expiry and delegation metadata are useful host-security additions but are not all established as Whitepaper v0.1 core fields. Their core-vs-extension/host-profile/later-revision status must be resolved before the training/release freeze.

Canonical JSON and canonical-Lattice positive/negative conformance fixtures now exist and execute through tests, but the corpus still needs broader production coverage, migration vectors, and complete carrier round-trip cases before freeze.

Systematic adversarial/property/fuzz coverage remains incomplete after the contract repair, especially permission preservation, compact-to-canonical equivalence, malformed canonical Lattice and migration ambiguity.
No independent second implementation has passed the Whitepaper-reconciled shared vectors or reproduced canonical bytes/semantics.
Whitepaper publication synchronization, source figures and reproducible publication build remain incomplete; the current PDF remains Level 1 during reconciliation.
SLAI adapter/launcher and pinned package/submodule integration are not implemented against a frozen Whitepaper-reconciled contract.
Final clean CI evidence, migration policy, compatibility evidence, release audit and pre-training freeze are incomplete.
